page.title: My Activity
page.purpose: Let a holder reconstruct exactly why their balance is what it is, including corrections, without ever showing another holder's activity.

priorities.statement: Every change to the balance is accounted for, in order, with the reason recorded at the time.
A correction is shown beside what it corrected, never in place of it.
priorities.notes: This is what makes the economy teachable rather than arbitrary — the mistake and its fix are both true.

priorities.statement: An upcoming expiry is visible before it happens.
priorities.notes: A balance that vanishes without warning destroys the trust the journal exists to build.

states.description: No activity yet; the page explains what will appear here.
Older history could not be loaded; what is shown is labelled as incomplete.
The authenticated holder does not match the requested holder; nothing is rendered.
Showing cached history after a failed refresh, labelled as such rather than presented as current.

elements.name: Activity
elements.description: Every event affecting this holder, newest first.

elements.name: Activity entry
elements.description: One event with its amount, reason and time.

elements.name: Correction
elements.description: Marks an entry as correcting an earlier one and points at it.

elements.name: Expiring soon
elements.description: Warns that part of the balance will expire.

claims.statement: The default state accounts for every balance change with a reason; no entry renders without one.
A compensating event is displayed alongside the event it corrects, and the original remains visible.
An upcoming expiry is surfaced before the balance changes.
The permission-denied state renders no events and does not disclose whether the requested holder exists.
